about: A family dessert maker whose spumoni recipe came from Naples to Chicago's Little Italy with Salvatore Lezza in 1905, now run by the third and fourth generations. The Bellwood plant on St. Charles Road makes cannoli, spumoni, cakes, cookies, gelato and Italian ice by hand for restaurants and stores.
tagline: Four generations of spumoni and cannoli, since 1905
hours: No hours published for Bellwood. Published hours are for the Elmhurst retail store: Sun 8am–5pm; Mon closed; Tue–Sat 7am–6pm (lezza.com/locations)
notes: IMPORTANT: Lezza's site lists 4009 St. Charles Rd, Bellwood as 'Wholesale / Manufacturing for Restaurants, Retail Stores & Distributors'; the retail bakery/gelateria is at 544 Spring Rd, Elmhurst (630-530-0630), opened Aug 2015. The history page says the Bellwood plant once had a small store in the production kitchen ('was'). Confirm whether Bellwood still sells walk-in retail before listing it on a trail. Restaurantji photos (2–4) are from Restaurantji's Bellwood listing but may have been taken at the Elmhurst shop.
